description.value: Como Taperia is a Spanish-style tapas restaurant located on East 7th Avenue in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood. The taperia format — small shared plates — can be a welcome change of pace for touring cyclists looking for a relaxed, social dining experience after a day on the road.
